status: DESIGN ONLY. Nothing here is implemented or executed: no Paper data is read, no Paper or collector change, no live trading, no credentials, no order. Any implementation needs a separate owner authorization (P2G-ADR-10 instrumentation gaps; Class B procedure for any production change).

paper_r1_reconciliation.purpose: compare, per Paper trade, three prices of the same intended execution, without using any outcome to choose fees, latency, slippage, stale thresholds or scenarios

a_paper_assumed_fill.source: PAPER-R1 trade.opened entry price (and the exit price at close)
a_paper_assumed_fill.provenance: ASSUMED (a Paper simulation price, not a market fill)

b_p2x_reference.source: P2-X legs under EXEC-IDEALIZED / EXEC-BASE / EXEC-STRESS for the same instrument at the Paper decision event_time_ms (collector book / depth, obs_id recorded)
b_p2x_reference.provenance: per component, as in the leg

c_future_real_fill.source: an exchange fill report, only if live trading were ever separately authorized
c_future_real_fill.provenance: MEASURED when it exists; UNAVAILABLE now

paper_r1_reconciliation.join: candidate_id -> signal_id -> tracker events (P2C_RESEARCH_LAYER section 8); market state as-of join on available_at_ms <= event_time_ms; requires the host clock offset per event (DERIVED from collector clock checks) and the collector book obs_id used for the Paper entry price (P2G-ADR-10 gap 2)
reported_differences: a - b.touch at T (bps, by scenario)
time offsets: Paper event_time_ms vs collector observed_at_ms of the reference quote
guards: Paper outcomes only outside W3 and only through a predeclared evaluation
differences are execution diagnostics, never inputs to alpha selection
no outcome-based tuning of any execution assumption

actual_fill_calibration_path.purpose: the fields a future, separately authorized real-order experiment must record so that components can move from ASSUMED / UNAVAILABLE toward MEASURED

fields.use: unique join key from decision to order to fills
links the order to the research decision
signal_decision and application_processing latency (MEASURED on the host)
network_to_order_entry + exchange ack latency (MEASURED, with clock offset)

fields.field: order status transitions (NEW, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, EXPIRED, REJECTED + reason)
fields.use: fill probability, refusal and rejection rates

fields.field: fills[]: trade id, price, qty, commission, commissionAsset, isMaker, trade time
fields.use: realized fill price, realized slippage vs the P2-X touch / depth walk at send time, partial fills, liquidity role

fields.field: commission totals in quote currency (with conversion source if paid in another asset)
fields.use: fee verification -> fee schedule VERIFIED_REALIZED_COMMISSIONS (provenance MEASURED) as a NEW fee schedule version

fields.field: collector book / depth obs_id at request_sent_ts and at transactTime
fields.use: reference prices for realized slippage and market impact measurement

actual_fill_calibration_path.promotion_rule: a component becomes MEASURED only from these recorded fields for the same venue, market type, order type and size range; until then it stays ASSUMED / ESTIMATED / UNAVAILABLE. Calibrated values enter as NEW contract versions; nothing is rewritten
